title: hamnir config
description: Configuration for hamnir, a persona-first OIDC dev provider. Note: referential rules (persona.group must match a groups[].id, and sub must be unique across personas) are enforced by hamnir at load time, not by this schema.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. Omit to derive the issuer per-request from the request host — this is what lets a browser (http://localhost:5556) and an in-cluster caller (http://hamnir:5556) each receive an issuer they can reach.

clients.description: Registered OAuth clients. Providing any client puts hamnir in strict mode: only these client_ids and their exact redirect URIs are accepted. Omit the whole block for permissive dev mode (any client_id and redirect_uri).

groups.description: Persona groups, used to organise and colour-code the persona picker.

scopes.description: Custom scope definitions mapping a scope name to the list of claim names it releases.

personas.description: The selectable identities shown in the persona picker.

redirect_uris.description: Exact redirect URIs permitted for this client.

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Exact post-logout redirect URIs permitted for this client.

secret.description: Client secret. Omit for a public client that authenticates with PKCE.

id.description: Unique group identifier, referenced by persona.group.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the persona picker.

colour.description: Accent colour as a 3- or 6-digit hex code, e.g. "#8b5cf6".

name.description: Display name shown in the persona picker.

description.description: Optional secondary text shown under the name in the picker.

group.description: Group id this persona belongs to. Must match a groups[].id (enforced by hamnir at load time).

claims.description: Claims released for this persona. Arbitrary claim keys are allowed; sub is required and must be unique across personas.

sub.description: Stable subject identifier. Required, and unique across personas.
